liturgicalName: Mary, the Holy Mother of God (Jan 1, optional)
keyVerseDR: "But Mary kept all these words, pondering them in her heart." (Lk 2:19)

level1.title: Mary, Our Mother
level1.story: The shepherds found Mary, Joseph, and Baby Jesus. Mary kept all these things in her heart. Mary is the Mother of God!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you love like Mary?
level1.prayer: Mother Mary, help me love Jesus. Amen.

activity.title: My rosary beads
activity.intro: Mary is our Mother. Color 10 beads and say a Hail Mary for each.
activity.label: One Hail Mary for each bead

level2.title: Mother of God
level2.story: The shepherds hurried to Bethlehem and found Mary, Joseph, and the baby lying in the manger. They told everyone what the angels had said about the child. All who heard it were amazed. Mary kept all these things, pondering them in her heart. After eight days, the baby was named Jesus, the name the angel had given Him.
level2.keyLine: Mary kept all these words, pondering them in her heart.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why do we call Mary the Mother of God?
What does it mean to ponder?
actions: Pray a decade of the Rosary
Start the year with a prayer
level2.prayer: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us. Amen.

activity.title: Hail Mary, Mother of God
activity.intro: Fill in the missing words of the prayer.
activity.text: Holy Mary, [Mother] of God, pray for us [sinners], now and at the hour of our death.
